capabilities: Track daily values in checkbox, shade, number, time and duration columns
Edit trackers through a right-click menu or keyboard
Draw line graphs, pie charts and heatmaps from any column
Lock trackers to restrict editing by date
Keep all tracker data as plain text in notes
extras: No network use, analytics or tracking; data never leaves the vault. README advises keeping plugin settings out of Obsidian Sync or Git (data.json) so appearance can differ per device.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log daily values such as habits, moods, times and durations in a note and chart them while keeping the data as plain text.
summary: Plain-text daily habit tracker with checkbox, shade, number, time and duration columns, plus charts drawn from any column.
